Name: Add to Workbench Chests
Author: Rui3
Description:
[size=2]Okay, disclaimer. I was gonna make a super nice gif to upload like I did for my Add To Fridges mod, but then ShareX decided it didn't want to play nice. All I can say is, last time I tested this (which was literally an hour ago as of writing this when I was [i]trying[/i] to make the gif) it worked, and also it's basically the same mod as Add To Fridges but made to work on the workbench, and Add To Fridges has been up for a couple months without any problems. [/size]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Access the workbench with the connected chests and there will be a button on the bottom right of the UI. Items will only transfer if there are 1 or more chests connected to the workbench.

Also there's a config file. If you set the colored chests icon to [b]false[/b] the chests on the icon will all be the same shade of brown rather than multicolored. Wow.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.4.5 on Windows. Unknown capability for other platforms/mobile. Let me know if there are issues and I'll see what I can do.
[*]Works in single player and should work in multiplayer as well.
[*]Not tested for compatibility with other mods that alter the Workbench UI. If conflicts exist, let me know and I'll see what I can do.
[/list]

[/list]
